verdict.rationale: The evidence documents a REST API and a downloadable OpenAPI spec that users can feed into generators to build their own client libraries, but it never mentions any official, vendor-published SDK. Self-generated clients from a spec are a developer building block, not an official SDK, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs

citations.quote: Download them to generate client libraries, import the API into tools like Postman, or give coding agents machine-readable API context
